provenance.paper_title: VideoARM: Adaptive Reasoning and Memory for Long Video Understanding

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: The observe-think-act-memorize loop retains and updates multilevel visual clues.
Hierarchical summaries provide long-range evidence to later reasoning steps.
A fixed controller consolidates observations into multilevel clues. For VideoARM, this specifically supports episodic or hierarchical summarization of multilevel visual clue memory.
The memorize step updates retained clues during video processing. For VideoARM, this specifically supports LLM-mediated memory editing of multilevel visual clue memory.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (multilevel visual clue memory) changes through episodic or hierarchical summarization, LLM-mediated memory editing; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
